basic_info.description: Enjoy northwest-facing city views from this well-designed 2-bed, 2-bath residence at Museum Parc. The open kitchen features ebony-hued countertops and flooring, wine storage, richly toned wood cabinetry, and modern appliances. Open-concept living and dining areas offer a flexible layout with oversized windows framing views with access to a private terrace.   The spacious primary suite comfortably fits a king-size bed and features two custom closets, built-in shelving, and a spa-inspired bath with a separate shower and soaking tub. Positioned on the opposite end of the layout, the expansive guest bedroom offers exceptional space, two closets including a generous walk-in and is ideally suited for comfort and privacy. In-home laundry completes the floor plan.   Residents of Museum Parc enjoy 24/7 front desk staff, package acceptance, and a landscaped courtyard. Secured parking is offered separately. Located moments from Yerba Buena Gardens, SF MoMa, MOAD, Oracle Park, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and a wide array of dining and cultural destinations. Crunch Fitness, with a heated outdoor lap pool, is located in the building. With a Walk Score of 96 and a Transit Score of 100, residents enjoy seamless access to BART, Muni, Caltrain, and major freeways.
